scope: Post-run audit of the six assigned native OAuth arms, from locally persisted receipts. Supplemental measurement with no effect on frozen scoring.

method.multiplicity: Group successful terminal provider summary rows with a digest by role and exact recorded normalized summary hash, within each arm. Cross-arm repetitions are descriptive only.
method.boundaryTiming: Use host creation epoch milliseconds and the matching provider admission/terminal journal timestamps. Estimate observer start from paired wall/monotonic samples using median offset plus half a millisecond for log quantization. Require a unique root digest match inside the guarded interval from this host creation to the next, and monotonic response ordering. Report unambiguous hash alone separately. Require logged same-session successful root reentry after summary finish, before a later summary request or host boundary.
method.postUseLimit: Checkpoint presence comes from the frozen scorer's recorded request IDs. Raw provider request bodies and host boundary completion timestamps are absent. The audit cross-checks timing and identity of those IDs and cannot replay checkpoint extraction, distinguish an identical checkpoint body by instance, or establish operand provenance.
method.bridgeLimit: Bridge answer correctness is an outcome. Seal delivery, fresh reads and procedure delivery are observations and do not establish where the model obtained both numerical operands.
method.scriptedLimit: The no-paid scripted bridge returned fixture.bridgeAnswer.units when the seal text was visible. Scripted evidence receives no operand-survival or independent-calculation credit and was excluded from this attribution audit.
